main_link_waveform.signaling: differential NRZ per lane, AC-coupled, embedded clock.
main_link_waveform.framing: Transfer Units of active video framed by BS/BE control symbols; MSA per frame; secondary-data packets (SS/SE) in blanking.
main_link_waveform.clocking: Panel Sink recovers the embedded clock with a CDR; no dedicated clock lane.

aux_waveform.transaction: SYNC preamble + START + (command[4] + address[20] + length) request, then panel reply, then STOP.

link_training_waveform.fast_link_training: Apply stored drive settings for the fixed embedded channel; send training patterns a short fixed interval.
link_training_waveform.CR_phase: TPS1 on all active lanes; adjust voltage swing / pre-emphasis until CR_DONE (full training).
link_training_waveform.EQ_phase: TPS2/3/4 until CHANNEL_EQ_DONE + SYMBOL_LOCKED + INTERLANE_ALIGN_DONE (full training).

msa_waveform.msa: Main Stream Attributes sent once per frame in vertical blanking: Mvid/Nvid, Htotal/Vtotal, HSP/HSW, active width/height, MISC0/MISC1.
msa_waveform.purpose: Lets the panel regenerate the pixel clock from the link clock; during PSR the panel uses its own timing.

hpd_waveform.irq_hpd: Short pulse signals a link-status / PSR event; Source re-reads DPCD.

general_timing_rule: The Main Link unit interval is set by the link rate (e.g. ~123.5 ps UI at 8.1 Gbps HBR3). The embedded clock is recovered per lane during CR (or applied directly in Fast Link Training); multi-lane links are de-skewed during EQ. The pixel clock is regenerated from Mvid/Nvid. PSR exit latency is minimized by Fast Link Training. AUX runs at a fixed ~1 Mbps Manchester-II independent of the Main Link rate.

voltage_levels.note: Swing + pre-emphasis selected per lane during CR (or stored for Fast Link Training); reduced-swing option for panel power.

psr_waveform.entry: Source enables PSR, transmits a final frame, quiesces the Main Link; panel latches the RFB.
psr_waveform.self_refresh: Main Link electrically idle; panel refreshes from the RFB at its own timing.
psr_waveform.exit: On update / IRQ_HPD: Fast Link Training + re-transmit (full frame, or PSR2 selective-update region).
